sentence: This project studies how cell fusion shapes gene expression and development, using the epidermis as a model system.
This project uses functional genomics and chemical biology to look for better ways to treat cancer in children.
This project tries to find out how sodium channels cluster at the neuromuscular junction and how this changes with aging and disease.
This project uses genetically diverse mice to find the genes that cause fentanyl addiction.
This project tests whether impaired action potential propagation along inhibitory interneuron axons drives Dravet syndrome in a mouse model.
This project measures stress in bereaved spouses using ecological momentary assessment and continuous electrocardiography in a naturalistic setting.
This project studies how bacteria that live in the intestines communicate with the immune system and make it more aggressive.
This project tries to find out how many small molecules acting together drive biological outcomes, starting with communication between the host and the microbiome.
This project studies how genetic risk affects innate immune cells over time in Parkinson's disease, using patient-derived models.
This project offers DNA sequencing and data analysis services to researchers, including sample preparation and library construction.
This project studies how hypoxia and tumor metabolism affect the response to immunotherapy in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
This project builds a compact CRISPR system that activates distal enhancers of a gene in a neonatal mouse model of alveolar capillary dysplasia.
This project studies how variants of the Apolipoprotein E gene affect the immune response to viruses in Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies severe malaria and severe malarial anemia in children in western Kenya, along with co-infections such as tuberculosis.
This project uses genome editing or gene addition to get liver sinusoidal endothelial cells to produce a clotting factor in hemophilia A.
This project studies how a family of membrane proteins works to make fatty acids, lipids, and alcohols.
This project studies how temporal prediction shapes the way the primate visual system processes visual information in cortex.
This project turns a web application into a commercial product that helps researchers visualize and analyze RNA sequencing data.
This project studies how HIV persists, what controls HIV after treatment, and how resistance to antiretroviral agents affects patients.
This project studies the biological, genetic, and other factors that contribute to cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic syndrome.
